title: The Codex account generation advances when a /login fails before any provider change
outcome: A /login or /logout that fails before it changes any provider credential leaves saved Codex threads resumable, instead of marking them as from an older account.
acceptance: A /login that fails before account/login/start (for example a refused readback) leaves the account generation unchanged, or saved threads stamped with the previous generation still resume, shown by a behaviour test.
An action that does change the provider credential still advances the generation.
